data.name: Anuvrat
data.gender_notes: Anuvrat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anuvrat is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘anuvrat’ meaning devotion, duty, or loyalty. This name is rooted in the Hindu religious tradition and is considered an auspicious and noble name for a baby boy. The name embodies the spiritual values of commitment, respect, and obedience to one's elders and deities. The name Anuvrat carries the meaning “Devotion, Duty, Loyalty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anuvrat usually hope their child will grow to embody devotion, duty, loyalty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires devotion and loyalty.
data.etymology: Anuvrat belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devotion, Duty, Loyalty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anuvrat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_sanskrit.name: Anuvrat
in_sanskrit.meaning: dedication, devotion, observance, adherence to vows, obedience, respect, homage, reverence, obeisance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anu means 'towards' and Vrat means 'vow' or 'promise'. Anuvrat means moving towards a vow or promise, and thus it represents dedication, devotion, observance, adherence to vows, obedience, respect, homage, reverence, and obeisance.

data.cultural_impact: Anuvrat is a name rich in cultural significance in Hinduism. It is a name that signifies loyalty, dedication, and obedience to one's elders, gurus, and deities. The name is deeply rooted in Indian culture and is often associated with noble and virtuous individuals who have exemplary character and uphold the values of their community. In Hindu society, the name Anuvrat is considered an auspicious and pious name, and bestows blessings of good fortune, prosperity, and happiness upon the child.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Anuvrat holds profound spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is a name that embodies the deep-rooted Hindu values of commitment, respect, and obedience to one's spiritual teachers, elders, and deities. The name Anuvrat signifies the inner quality of devotion and loyalty to the divine, and those who bear this name are encouraged to lead a virtuous and pious life, upholding the sacred duty of self-realization and spiritual growth. The name Anuvrat serves as a constant reminder of the Hindu spiritual path, and inspires the individual to align their actions and thoughts with the divine will, and to seek the blessings and guidance of the divine in all aspects of their life.

historical_references.reference: Anuvrat was a legendary Jain monk who is believed to have lived during the 11th or 12th century CE. He was a disciple of Mahavira, the last Tirthankara of Jainism. Anuvrat is known for his immense spiritual strength and self-discipline. His name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anuvrata' which means 'one who follows the vows'. He is considered an important figure in Jain monastic traditions and is revered by Jains around the world.

Anuvrat is also mentioned in the Puranic literature of Hinduism, specifically in the Skanda Purana. In this text, Anuvrat is described as a sage and a devotee of Lord Shiva. He is said to have performed severe penances to attain the grace of Shiva and is granted a boon that he would be revered by all beings.
